=== Delete at the end of an item removes an empty first child
--- given
- a‸
  -
--- when key Delete
--- then
- a‸

=== Delete at the end of an empty item pulls the next item in
--- given
- ‸
- b
--- when key Delete
--- then
- ‸b

=== Delete between two items with content swallows the key
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when key Delete
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Delete at the end of a line joins the next notes line
--- given
- a‸
  note
--- when key Delete
--- then
- a‸note

=== Delete on a folded item never touches what it hides
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  -
--- when key Delete
--- then consumed
- a‸ ⊟
  -

=== Delete away from the line end passes to the editor
--- given
- a‸b
--- when key Delete
--- then passthrough
- a‸b

=== Delete on the last item of a list swallows the key
--- given
- a
- b‸
--- when key Delete
--- then consumed
- a
- b‸

=== Delete pulls the next item's children under this one
--- given
- ‸
- b
  - c
--- when key Delete
--- then
- ‸b
  - c
